name: US–China / Taiwan
summary: China held unannounced drills with over 100 vessels around Taiwan in early November; no blockade or clash found
state: Taiwanese officials said China deployed more than 100 naval and coast guard vessels around Taiwan and the western Pacific in early November without announcing drills, though this does not show a decision to blockade (IBTimes, citing Reuters). Taiwan's defence minister described 'area denial' drills on 10 Nov (ThePrint/Reuters). A $14 billion US arms package for Taiwan remained stalled as Trump and Xi met at APEC in Shenzhen in the week of 17 Nov (AP via La Nación). No blockade or military clash was found.
for_you: No direct effect for most people now. A Taiwan crisis would disrupt chip and electronics supply chains.
rubric_hit: Large-scale PLA exercises around Taiwan = Watch

sources.title: IBTimes — China unannounced naval deployment around Taiwan

why: The world's two largest economies; a Taiwan crisis would halt most advanced chip supply and risk great-power war.
drivers: PLA exercises, tariffs and tech controls, diplomacy, Taiwan politics, South China Sea incidents.

rubric.alert: Blockade or 'quarantine' of Taiwan, military clash, or severed diplomatic channels.
rubric.watch: Large-scale PLA exercises around Taiwan, major new sanctions/controls, or a naval/air incident.
rubric.normal: Managed relations; dialogue channels open; routine PLA activity.
